Customer testimonial card: leads with a gradient result metric, then quote and attribution.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Testimonial` · Content

## Notes

Customer testimonial with a leading gradient metric and attribution.

## Props (TestimonialProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `metric` | `React.ReactNode` | Headline result, e.g. "847%". |
| `metricLabel` | `React.ReactNode` | Label beside the metric, e.g. "ROI in Year 1". |
| `quote` * | `React.ReactNode` | The quotation (no surrounding quote marks needed). |
| `name` * | `React.ReactNode` | Person's name. |
| `role` | `React.ReactNode` | Title / institution. |
| `photo` | `string` | Optional headshot URL; falls back to initials. |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>._
